independence.basis: Direct inspection of the complete canonical source pixels, not author inventory, spec, or review.

scene.description: One unlabelled apparatus scene: two upright tuning forks mounted separately on two horizontally separated rectangular boxes, and a small hammer near the upper outside of the right fork.
scene.instructionalFrame: The two assemblies share one scene, not independent labelled panels.
scene.sourceBorder: An irregular rectangular printed frame surrounds the apparatus; this is page presentation, not apparatus.

objects.description: Two long, narrow, approximately parallel upright arms with rounded ends and a clear open gap. They join in a curved U-shaped bottom.
objects.position: Above the left box, slightly left of its horizontal center.

objects.description: Short narrow stem descending from the joined bottom of the left fork toward its small support base.
Small dark, rounded or oval support footprint at the left stem's foot on the box top. Fine details are not resolved.
Rectangular box drawn in perspective, with a light top plane and broad stippled visible side or front plane; vertical end edges enclose its volume.
Two long, narrow arms with rounded ends and an open gap, joined by a curved U-shaped bottom; the assembly leans slightly right in the printed perspective.
objects.position: Above the right box, near its horizontal center.

objects.description: Short narrow stem below the right fork's joined bottom, terminating at a small dark support footprint.
Rounded or oval dark support footprint on the top plane of the right box. No separate clamp can be confidently identified.
Rectangular perspective box with light top and stippled broad visible side or front plane, separate from the left box.
Small short crosswise head on a long diagonal handle. The handle rises toward the upper right border; the head is adjacent to the outer upper area of the right fork.

relationships.fact: The left pair of arms joins into one bottom feeding one stem.
The left stem terminates on its own small base.
The left base rests on the top of the left box.
The right pair of arms joins into one bottom feeding one stem.
The right stem terminates on its own small base.
The right base rests on the top of the right box.
There are exactly two separate two-arm forks at comparable height in one scene; no measured equality or frequency value is printed.
There are exactly two separated boxes, one below each fork, with an unobstructed horizontal gap between them.
Only the right fork has the adjacent striking hammer. A clear intended strike relation must survive modernization; exact contact is not resolved in the original.

uncertainties: Facing hollow box openings are not reliably visible in these source pixels. Their existence and facing orientation must come from the complete edition prose, not a claim that the scan resolves them.
Dark fork support footprints are visible, but their hardware type and fasteners are not resolved. Do not invent a clamp attached to a fork arm.
Wood identity, resonance, identical frequency, sound-transfer behavior, and a later experiment clip are textual facts, not independently inferable from these pixels.
Printed stippling and irregular black border are historical reproduction texture, not instructional requirements.
modernizationConstraints: Keep both two-arm fork outlines, open arm gaps, joined bottoms, stems and separate support bases.
Keep two box volumes and their separation; use text-authorized inward-facing openings without filling them so they read as solid ends.
Keep a recognizable hammer clearly related to the right fork without a fabricated clamp.
Do not add labels, frequency values, sound waves, arrows, outcomes or other answer-bearing marks.
Omit historical border, print stipple, aged-paper texture and cultural text or symbols.
